subject: Attention Students- Shortlisted Candidate 24kd1a05p3 Online Training & AICTE Internship Certification Program 2026.
body:
*Dear Student 24kd1a05p3*,

*Congratulations on being shortlisted for the exclusive Internship Program!* We
are pleased to inform you that Averixis Solutions Pvt Ltd, in collaboration
with leading* MNCs, Startup's, IIM-Ahmedabad and IIT Bombay ,* is offering
a 2-Month Training + Internship program designed by industry *(MNC'S)*
 experts.

The program focuses on *practical skill development, Real time
project-based learning, and career readiness*, ensuring participants are
well-prepared for internships and entry-level roles in today’s competitive
job market.
1.  Program Overview:

   - Learning Phase:
      - Engage in *live lectures and mentorship sessions* with industry
      professionals.
      - Access your personalized* LMS Portal to interact with trainers and
      peers.* Login credentials will be provided upon registration.

   - Internship Phase:
      - Work on a *LIVE INDUSTRY PROJECT* under the guidance of
      professional mentors.
      - Complete *10+ minor projects* individually, gaining hands-on
      experience in each topic.
      - Collaborate on a* major group project (Capstone).*
   - Learning Model:
      - Successful candidates will be offered a

*stipend-based Internship. *

*Who Can Apply:* Students from any stream or technical background.

*To proceed and secure your slot, please complete the mandatory Google Form
linked below. If you are further shortlisted, our HR Team will reach out to
you.*

*Apply Here: https://forms.gle/ZTsfnsGe89sLsTLe9
<https://forms.gle/ZTsfnsGe89sLsTLe9>*
2. What You Will Learn:

   - Modern application development using Low-Code / No-Code platforms.
   - Fundamentals of Generative AI tools used in the industry.
   - Prompt Engineering techniques for real-world AI use cases.
   - Problem-solving through hands-on assignments and guided labs.

3. Internship & Project Exposure:

   - Participation in multiple real-time projects.
   - Team-based capstone project aligned with industry use cases.
   - Exposure to professional workflows and documentation standards.
   - Performance-based opportunities during the internship phase.

4.  Certifications:

   - Course Certificate: Receive a prestigious certificate from
*IIM-Ahmedabad. *
   - Internship Certificate: Earn a certificate from our partnered
   companies to bolster your resume.
   - Verified by WIPRO Dice ID: Gain credible and valuable credentials
   recognized in the industry.
   - 100% Placement Assistance: Join Our Growth Community for Direct
   Placement Support with Top Companies.

5. Career Benefits by this Program:

   - Program completion and internship certifications.
   - Resume enhancement and career profiling support.
   - Interview preparation sessions and career mentoring.
   - Access to placement assistance resources and hiring networks.
   - Learn skills that companies actively look for.
   - Gain experience beyond classroom theory.
   - Build a strong project portfolio before graduation.
   - Get structured guidance from experienced mentors.

This program perfectly combines theoretical knowledge, practical
experience, and industry exposure. Equip yourself with the essential skills
and insights to excel in your chosen field. We’re excited to welcome you
and look forward to an amazing journey together.!

"Achieve your dream job even during economic downturns."


Thanks & Regards
Averixis Solutions
